environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in account 112233445566, running with execution role 'NotificationServiceRole' which has AdministratorAccess managed policy attached. Function is behind API Gateway with no request validation. Lambda runtime Python 3.11, Jinja2 3.1.2 installed via layer. No SCP applied to the account. The function accepts arbitrary JSON payloads including user-supplied template strings via the 'custom_template' field.
